title: The Cesti (fragments of books 7 and 2)
edition: PG 10; Cesti fragmenta (Khazarzar extract of book 7)
author: Julius Africanus
blurb: Julius Africanus, Cesti (Embroidered Girdles). Tip of book 7 through the colophon, and book 2 through gluing a wound without suture (2.1–2.8). New English from locked PG 10 Greek. Remainder of book 2 and a book-7 appendix after the colophon are not in this volume. No previous English of the Cesti body is known; ANF translates the letters only.
era_note: Sextus Julius Africanus, Christian chronographer and encyclopedist, early third century. This page is a tip of book 7, not the whole Cesti.
first_english_note: No complete English of the Cesti body is known. ANF (Roberts) translates Africanus's letters, not this encyclopedic fragment. This is a new rendering from locked PG 10 Greek.

text_history.method: New English from locked PG 10 / Khazarzar Greek of Cesti book 7 through colophon and book 2.1–2.8. Earlier lemma-led scaffold English was discarded. Remainder of book 2 and the book-7 appendix held.
